data.gender_notes: Boazara is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'boaz', meaning 'strength' or 'mighty' and 'ara', meaning 'exalted' or 'raised high'. Boazara is a beautiful name for a girl, symbolizing God's blessings and strength. The name Boazara carries the meaning “Blessed by God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Boazara usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Boazara total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: בואזרה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם בואזרה הוא שילוב של שני שמות עבריים - בואז וזרע, שמשמעותו היא זרע החסד והאמת. בואז היה שם של קרוב משפחה של רוט במגילת רוט, והוא סימל את החסד והנאמנות. השם בואזרה מבטא את התקווה לזרע חדש שיבוא ויחזק את המשפחה והחברה על בסיס ערכים אלו.

in_greek.name: Βοαζαρά
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Βοαζαρά είναι σύνθεση δύο εβραϊκών ονομάτων - Βοοζ και Ζάρα, που σημαίνει σπόρος πίστεως και αλήθειας. Ο Βοοζ ήταν συγγενής της Ρουθ στην Παλαιά Διαθήκη και συμβόλιζε την πίστη και την αφοσίωση. Το όνομα Βοαζαρά εκφράζει την ελπίδα για νέο σπόρο που θα δυναμώσει την οικογένεια και την κοινωνία με βάση αυτές τις αξίες.

in_latin.name: Boazara
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Boazara est compositum ex duobus nominibus hebraicis - Booz et Zara, quod significat semen misericordiae et veritatis. Booz fuit propinquus Ruth in Veteri Testamento et misericordiam et fidelitatem significabat. Nomen Boazara spem novi seminis exprimit, quod familiam et societatem hisce valoribus fundabit.

in_english.name: Boazara
in_english.meaning: Seed of kindness and truth in family and society
in_english.long_meaning: The name Boazara is derived from Hebrew roots Boaz and Zara, signifying seed of kindness and truth. Boaz, a relative of Ruth in the Old Testament, symbolized mercy and loyalty. Boazara conveys hope for a new generation strengthening family and community on these values. It represents spiritual heritage and character traits like compassion, honesty, and faithfulness, cherished across Christian cultures.

The name carries a rich cultural heritage and could be seen as a reminder of the strong foundation of faith that has shaped Christian traditions.

Whether in personal prayer or in worship with a community, the name Boazara serves as a powerful reminder of the spiritual foundation of the Christian faith.
